children: AptarGroup said its Russian subsidiary Aptar Vladimir was placed under temporary external administration by a presidential decree and the company is assessing options to protect its rights.
The decree, published Sept. 21, 2026, places Aptar Vladimir under temporary external administration.
AptarGroup is assessing the situation and options and committed to protecting its shareholder rights.
As of Dec. 31, 2025, Aptar Vladimir accounted for under 0.6% of consolidated net sales and operating income.
The company warned potential risks include operational, legal, accounting or sanction impacts and possible impairment.
